depiction.primary_object: rounded rectangular badge containing capital letters SD
depiction.composition: centered horizontal badge with blocky two-letter text

readings.meaning: standard definition video quality (SD vs HD/4K)
SD memory card or Secure Digital storage
South Dakota or San Diego abbreviation

ambiguity: Although intended as a video player UI badge for Standard Definition (480p), in a task list most people associate 'SD' with an SD memory card (though physical SD card icons have a notched corner and gold pins), or the number '50' at very small sizes.

reasoning: The icon is a pure text badge ('SD' in a rectangle) representing a media quality setting (Standard Definition) rather than a concrete object. Under the guidelines, icons consisting only of letters/digits or depicting only a property/setting should be discarded, and for physical SD memory cards a notched card silhouette is far clearer.
